prompt: The film discussion runs until eight. If you want to leave before the discussion begins, please _____ during the interval so you will not have to cross in front of the screen while the film is playing.
promptZh: 映後座談持續到八點。如果你想在座談開始前離開，請在中場休息時離開，這樣就不必在影片播放時走過銀幕前方。

options.whyZh: do so 回指前面的 leave；please 後接原形，讀者因此知道要在中場休息時離開。
so do 通常用在 So do I 之類的附和句，表示「我也是」，不能代替這個祈使句的離開動作。

options.zh: 這麼做（動名詞或分詞形式）
options.whyZh: doing so 可當主詞或分詞片語，如 Doing so would help；please 後不是這類結構，需要原形動詞。
have done so 表示動作已完成，不適合用來請觀眾在稍後的中場休息時做這件事。

explanationZh: do so 回指前面的 leave；please 後接原形，讀者因此知道要在中場休息時離開。
evidence: The film discussion runs until eight. If you want to leave before the discussion begins, please do so during the interval so you will not have to cross in front of the screen while the film is playing.
